newsitem.title: SUDAN: Sudan alleges human rights abuses by Ethiopia.
newsitem.headline: Sudan alleges human rights abuses by Ethiopia.

text.p: A Sudan government report published on Tuesday accused Ethiopia of human rights abuses in a southern Sudanese state where Khartoum alleges Ethiopian troops are fighting alongside rebels.
Ethiopia has denied its troops are in the Blue Nile state, where a rebel offensive gained momentum in January with the capture of two towns, Kurmuk and Qissan.

The official Sudan news agency quoted the report as saying it would submit to international human rights groups the names of civilians killed in the Blue Nile state. It was the second time in a week Sudan alleged Ethiopian human rights abuses in Kurmuk and Qissan.
The reports have not been independently confirmed.
